name: Ribbon of Green
source:
"I'm sorry for everything. But even if I die, I will continue waiting for you," says the girl who lived on borrowed time. 

One cold, windy and cruel night, a girl with reddish brown hair wanders aimlessly, approaching the place she might have once called home.

One cold, windy and cruel night, a black-haired female student sits in an abandoned playground, letting the creaking old swing decide her direction.

This is their story.

Ribbon of Green focuses on hope, strength and friendship within this competitive world of nothing but survival of the fittest and elitism. In a society like this, if you lose hope, nobody would help you. It will be all over.

[From original website]
translation:
“对不起。但即使我死了，我也会继续等你。”那个活在借来的时间里女孩说道。

一个寒冷、刮风又残酷的夜晚，一个红棕色头发的女孩漫无目的地游荡，走向那个或许曾被称为家的地方。

一个寒冷、刮风又残酷的夜晚，一个黑发女学生坐在废弃的游乐场里，让吱呀作响的旧秋千决定她的方向。

这是她们的故事。

《Ribbon of Green》聚焦于希望、力量和友谊，在这个充斥着适者生存和精英主义的竞争世界里。在这样的社会中，一旦失去希望，就没有人会帮你。一切都将结束。
